description:
[read-only] Every paused campaign of the brand on every network, with each ad's text, headline, button and destination, and the pre-launch checks (destination resolves, UTM tags, button, end date or lifetime budget, max spend, call to action, same destination across networks), each pass, warn or fail. Read-only: it never switches a campaign on or spends; switching on stays with the owner in the app.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/launch-review.)

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. Omitted: the key's brand (a brand-bound key) or the owner's active brand (required once the account is in more than one organization).

name: ads_launch_review
title: Launch review of paused campaigns
